subject: general
question:
The following pie chart shows the population of a town.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/df048e1d26e33cc50a1af9a26bfd7da608cca3973352022d2632945ae6def387.png] 

If the total population of the town is 720000, then the number of animals in the town is:
solution:
According to the question

Animals are 1/12th part of the town's population [30°/360° = 1/12]

So Animals = 720000 × 1/12

⇒ 60000

**∴ The number of animals in the town is 60000**
